pages.text: The cursorium is a list of instructions held by each spellform, aggregated from a slate’s inscribed glyphs. These instructions are executed according to the order of aggregation, that is, starting from the top-left and moving rightward, wrapping downwards at the end of each line.$(br2)These instructions run instantaneously, unless a delay

glyph is used. The cursorium can also be added to through operations involving quotations.$(br2)For further detail please refer to the entry $(l:lingua_mundi:computation_specifics/quotations)On Quotations$(), in the section $(l:lingua_mundi:computation_specifics)Specifics of Computation$().
